generation_method.character: create_character(mode=v3, body_type=humanoid, n_directions=8, view=low top-down, size=246, completed_size=240x240)
generation_method.animation: animate_character(mode=v3, animation_name=move, directions=all 8, frame_count=6, one animation_group_id)
generation_method.cli_attempt: tools/pixellab_generate_pack.py attempted with config-derived token; hung on animate_character response before writing output, exact child terminated; direct exposed PixelLab MCP used for same character animation group.

runtime_scale_policy: per-frame alpha crop scaled to 246px visible height, nearest-neighbor, centered X, bottom aligned
prompt: Adult human elemental mage hero for FantasyDisk, dark fantasy D&D tabletop pixel art, heroic roster-class anatomy and grounded top-down RPG silhouette. Preserve deep blue layered cloak and mantle, brown hair, empty relaxed hands, brown boots, restrained ember/cyan/gold/stone cloth accents. No green glow or aura, particles, spell effects, weapon, held prop, costume swaps, chibi head, or body morph.
frame_selection_notes: PixelLab v3 custom returned 7 frames per direction (reference frame index 0 plus 6 animated frames); source pack stores animated frames 1..6 as 00..05. All 8 directions belong to one animation group; no flips or mirrors used.
known_residual_risk: No bright-green glow pixels remain under the committed QA rule; independent QA should still inspect the cleaned directional animation in-engine.

source_cleanup.method: PixelLab edit_image_pixen applied once to every final source frame; six palette-outlier frames received PixelLab reference edit_image correction; one north-east frame received deterministic hue sanitation after the reference edit job stalled and was cancelled.
